title: 第六十六章 心玲别怕伯父带你杀人第六十五章 心有不平气我自当杀人
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 租界内部。
几位脸色煞白，惊恐无比的秘武高手，连滚带爬，屁滚尿流，向着这边奔来。
他们好不容易才从林玄手底逃出，一个个内心全都崩溃了，浑身上下到现在还有鲜血未干。
这些鲜血都是从其他人身上飞出来的。
从未有任何时候，他们这般恐惧过。
杀人如麻！
这是真正的杀人如麻！
那个老将太恐怖了！
他们不知道有多少同伴，都被直接击毙、打爆。
还有被活生生的撕开。
那淋漓的血水、恐怖的画面，简直要永远印在他们的脑海，让他们一辈子都无法忘掉。
一旦想起，就会浑身发抖、灵魂颤抖。
粗步估计，也有三四百人被彻彻底底的打死了。
这简直是在屠杀！！！
“总董大人，老将军出现了！”
“救命啊，前朝老将大开杀戒，死了无数人啊...”
这几位秘武高手凄厉大叫。
整个租界一片轰动。
数不清的洋人在进行集结。
海岸线上，战舰发出一阵阵刺耳的呜鸣声音，浓烟滚滚，战炮林立。
同一时间。
城郊。
瀛溟国工厂所在。
这是一处外表以工厂掩护的地下实验室。
从外面看去。
一根根粗大的烟囱笔直林立，里面往外冒着滚滚白眼。
整个工厂占地异常巨大，四周用严密的铁丝网牢牢围住。
铁丝网内，还修建一座座高耸的塔楼。
上面屹立着一位位目光冷漠的瀛溟国高手。
地下区域。
一处处宽大的囚牢中不断传来一阵阵混乱的叫喊，伴随着囚牢被拍打的声音。
“放我出去！快放我出去！”
“你们这群该死的瀛溟国人，你们会遭到报应的！”
“饶命啊，我愿意投靠瀛溟国，求你们饶了我啊...”
“不要！我不要被注射药剂，啊！！！”
一阵阵凄厉的惨叫发出。
content_en:
Inside the concession.
Several secret martial arts masters with pale faces and extremely frightened were running towards this side, crawling and peeing.
They finally escaped from Lin Xuan's hands, and each of them was shattered. There is still blood all over their bodies.
The blood flew out from other people's bodies.
Never before had they been so scared.
Killing like hemp!
This is real murder!
That veteran is so scary!
They didn't know how many of their comrades were directly shot to death or blown up.
And being torn apart alive.
The dripping blood and horrific scenes will be imprinted in their minds forever, making them unable to forget them for the rest of their lives.
Once I think of it, my whole body will tremble and my soul will tremble.
Ruobu estimated that three to four hundred people were completely beaten to death.
This is simply massacre! ! !
"My lord, the old general has appeared!"
"Help, the veterans of the previous dynasty went on a killing spree and countless people died..."
These secret martial arts masters screamed miserably.
There was a sensation throughout the concession.
Countless foreigners are gathering.
On the coastline, warships made harsh whine sounds, thick smoke billowed, and war cannons stood in clusters.
...
at the same time.
suburbs.
Yingmingguo factory is located.
This is an underground laboratory covered by a factory.
View from the outside.
Thick chimneys stand upright, with white eyes billowing out from inside.
The entire factory occupies an extremely large area and is surrounded by a tight barbed wire fence.
Within the barbed wire fence, towering towers were also built.
Standing on top are masters from Yingming Kingdom with cold eyes.
underground area.
Chaotic shouts continued to be heard from every large prison, accompanied by the sound of the prison being slapped.
"Let me out! Let me out quickly!"
"You damn Yingming people, you will be punished!"
"Spare my life, I am willing to take refuge in Yingming Kingdom, please spare me..."
"No! I don't want to be injected with medicine, ah!!!"
...
Waves of shrill screams came out.
title_en: Chapter 66: Xinling, don’t be afraid that your uncle will lead you to kill someone. Chapter 65: If I feel grievances, I will commit suicide.
